title: The Tuesday checkout dip
hook: Checkout completion fell 14 percent on a single Tuesday and nobody can say why yet.
brief_md:
## Situation

A 14 percent drop in checkout completion showed up in Tuesday's funnel dashboard. Support has not flagged anything unusual and the on-call engineer says no incident was declared.

## Your job

Find the root cause using the warehouse. Confirm it with data before you name it, and be ready to say what evidence would prove your explanation wrong.

objectives.label: Isolate which funnel step the drop is concentrated in
Rule out a volume artifact before naming a cause

detector.prompt: Did the learner check whether raw attempt volume itself changed, before concluding the failure RATE changed?
